summary:
Frontend-only verification of iteration 64 (Aufmassprofi /sketches/draw) focused on three new features: (A) Progress text [data-testid=line-measure-progress] (B) Wall height section [data-testid=wall-section-toggle + wall-height-all/line + wall-deduction-line + wall-line-area + wall-sum-area] (C) Tone/volume picker component LaserSoundOptions ([data-testid=laser-tone-1..3, laser-volume-down, laser-volume-up, laser-volume-value]) shown in panel when Ton AN and in the Bemaßungspfeil modal. Route: tablet 768x1024 localhost, dismiss disclaimer/tour, Polygon tool -> 4 clicks (200,350)(500,350)(500,600)(200,600) + close (205,355), Edit tool, click segment midpoint (350,350). All automation ran without any console error, pageerror, or React Native red screen.

VERIFIED (direct observation):
1) Progress fresh closed 4-point polygon, segment 1 selected -> 'Linie 1 von 4 · 4 offen'. With 'Nächste Linie' AN, type+Add 2.91m -> 'Linie 2 von 4 · 3 offen'; 3.62m -> 'Linie 3 von 4 · 2 offen'; 2.91m -> 'Linie 4 von 4 · 1 offen'; 3.62m -> panel auto-closes. Reopen top segment -> 'Linie 1 von 4 · alle bemaßt'. Reopen right segment -> 'Linie 2 von 4 · alle bemaßt'.
2) Wall section: collapsed by default (only 44 px header row visible, header text 'Wandhöhe' when no wall). Expand -> 3 inputs 'Höhe alle Linien' / 'Höhe diese Linie' / 'Abzug diese Linie (m²)'. Type '2,50m' into wall-height-all on a 2,91m line -> wall-line-area = 'Diese Linie: 7,28 m²', wall-sum-area = 'Alle Wände: 32,66 m² (4 von 4)', header = 'Wandfläche: 32,66 m²'. Selecting the right segment (3,62m line): line-area = 'Diese Linie: 9,05 m²', wall-height-all persists value '2,50m'.
3) Override: on the 3,62m line type '3m' into wall-height-line and '1,8' into wall-deduction-line -> wall-line-area = 'Diese Linie: 9,06 m²', wall-sum-area = 'Alle Wände: 32,67 m² (4 von 4)'. Clearing both fields returns wall-line-area to 'Diese Linie: 9,05 m²'. Matches spec exactly.
4) Fast burst input (page.keyboard.type delay=5 '2.50m') into wall-height-all while 'Laser sofort übernehmen' is AN produced exactly '2.50m' in wall-height-all AND the main measurement input value stayed empty before/after - burst did NOT trigger addMeasurementToSelectedLine. line-area recomputed to '7,28 m²' correctly.
5) Sound options: Ton chip AUS -> options completely absent from DOM. Click chip -> AN; row with laser-tone-1/2/3 + laser-volume-down + laser-volume-value + laser-volume-up all render. Tone 1 active by default (bg rgb(25,118,210)); volume 100%, volume-up disabled=null but opacity conveys disabled via grey icon (functional: pressing up at 100 stays 100 because setLaserVolume clamps). Click laser-tone-2 -> tone-2 bg becomes rgb(25,118,210), tone-1 becomes rgb(245,245,245). Click laser-volume-down twice -> '50%'.
6) Persistence (localStorage): after pre-seeding aufmassprofi_laser_tone='1', aufmassprofi_laser_volume='50', aufmassprofi_laser_sound='1' and full reload + redraw, the panel restored tone-2 active (bg rgb(25,118,210)) and volume '50%', Ton chip shows 'AN'. Keys persist across reload exactly per spec.
7) Phone layout 390x844: all 3 tone buttons + volume down/value/up visible, no overlap/clipping; panel scrolls so Cancel/Done remain reachable but the panel is TALL enough that not everything fits in the viewport without scrolling when Ton AN + Wall section expanded. The row wraps to 2 lines (tone buttons row + volume controls row). See /tmp/iter64_phone.png.
8) Console: zero console.error events and zero pageerror events across all four UI runs (fresh polygon build, measurement burst, override, phone layout).
9) Regression unit tests (code level): `cd /app/frontend && npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter64_wall_area.test.ts` prints OK; `npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter60_buffered_input_sequence.test.ts` prints OK.
10) Measurements regression: adding 4 measurements, Zurück, Nächste Linie auto-advance, area chip (Fläche m²) showing '10,53 m²', green check highlight all still function.

COVERED BY CODE REVIEW ONLY (not directly automated):
- Open polyline progress 'von 3': code at draw.tsx:7668 uses segmentCountOf(element) which for an open polyline with N points returns N-1 (see /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts segmentCountOf). The '>=2 segments' guard at line 7669 correctly suppresses the progress text for single-segment lines. I was unable to easily build a 3-point OPEN polyline via the Polygon tool (which auto-closes) in this test harness, but the formula and guard are straightforward. 3-segment OPEN polyline => 'Linie X von 3 · N offen'.
- Unmeasured line with height set: /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/WallHeightSection.tsx:60 shows 'Diese Linie: {lineArea !== null ? formatAreaM2(lineArea) : '– (Maß und Höhe nötig)'}' and :63-65 shows 'Alle Wände: ... (walls von segments)'; wallSegmentAreaM2 (wallArea.ts) returns null unless BOTH measure and height exist. Code path is correct: unmeasured segment with wall.height set yields '– (Maß und Höhe nötig)' and the sum counts e.g. 3 of 4. Not fabricated through UI because measuring is auto-advance; would need to deliberately skip one which is not blocked by any UI affordance.
- Persistence of polygonWalls across editor close/reopen (not just reload of the editor page): wired via save payload at draw.tsx:1522, :2203, :5996 (metadata.polygonWalls = polygonWalls) and load at :1816, :1849 (setPolygonWalls(metadata.polygonWalls || {})). A pure in-editor reload of a 'TEST_ITER64_D' projectId that never hit the save/check button rebuilt empty (elements=0) because no autosave fired for this preview during the short test window. This tests the SAVE path not the DATA path; the data path is clearly wired. Recommend main agent manually press the top-right check to save then reopen to confirm end-to-end.
- PDF: /app/frontend/services/ProjectPdfService.ts:618 computes `wall: calculateWallAreaM2(el, segMeasures[el.id], metadata.polygonWalls?.[el.id])?.total ?? null`; :685 `hasWalls = filledSketchAreas.some(s => s.areas.some(a => a.wall !== null))`; :696 header becomes 'Grundfläche' (with 'Wandfläche' column appended) when hasWalls, else legacy single 'm²' column. :708-712 totals row includes areaTotal and wallTotal when hasWalls. Matches spec exactly. Not opened in UI (no PDF preview flow reached).
- Arrow modal LaserSoundOptions: draw.tsx:8277 `<Switch testID="arrow-laser-sound-switch" value={laserSound} onValueChange={changeLaserSound} />` then :8279-8283 `{laserSound && <View><LaserSoundOptions /></View>}` — the SAME component imported from the same file is rendered below the switch, bound to the same tone/volume state. It will therefore reflect the exact same values. Not directly opened (same arrow-tool-button testID gap as iter 63). Static review confirms correctness.

Audibility of the tone cannot be verified from browser automation (expo-audio runs on web as a silent no-op if the autoplay policy blocks it; no console error observed during tone preview clicks).

issues: When BOTH Ton is AN (LaserSoundOptions row visible) AND the Wandhöhe section is expanded, the panel is taller than 844 px so the body scrolls; Cancel/Done stay reachable via scroll but are below the fold. Consider making the panel body a ScrollView with sticky Cancel/Done, or collapsing the two optional sections into a single '…more' drawer on phone-width.

Chip label 'Ton' with its 'AN' badge still truncates to 'T… AN' / 'T… AUS' at 390x844 because the chip is 75 px wide and 'Ton' + Switch-badge compete for the single flex row (carried over from iter 62/63). Shortening the badge to a tiny dot or widening the chip to full-row width would fix it.

test_report_links: Inline Playwright scripts executed via browser_automation.

Screenshots: /tmp/iter64_load.png (initial toolbar), /tmp/iter64_panel.png (panel at seg1 of 4), /tmp/iter64_walls.png (header 'Wandfläche: 32,66 m²' + 7,28 m²), /tmp/iter64_override.png (9,06 m² + 32,67 m²), /tmp/iter64_sound.png (tone-2 active / 50%), /tmp/iter64_sound_restored.png (after reload - tone-2 restored, 50% restored), /tmp/iter64_phone.png (390x844 layout).
action_items: (Design nit, phone only) When the panel grows taller than 844 px (Ton AN + Wandhöhe expanded), the body overflows below the viewport and only the top of the panel is directly tappable without scroll. Suggest wrapping the panel body in a ScrollView with the Cancel/Done row as sticky footer on phone viewports.

(Design nit, carried over) Chip label 'Ton' + 'AN'/'AUS' badge truncates to 'T… AN' on 390x844 because the chip is only 75 px wide. Either shorten the badge, widen the chip, or hide the volume icon on phone.

(Optional) Give the arrow-tool toolbar button an explicit testID (e.g. testID='arrow-tool-button') so that the next automation run can open the Bemaßungspfeil modal without relying on the ambiguous 'Measure Line' label (also raised in iter 63).

No production bug found in the three new iteration-64 features; all directly-observed scenarios match the spec values byte-for-byte (7,28 / 9,05 / 9,06 / 32,66 / 32,67 m² and 'Linie X von N · Y offen' / 'alle bemaßt').
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/WallHeightSection.tsx:19-71 - Clean, isolated component. 3 fields correctly route changes to either the shared wall (height) or the per-segment slot (segment.height, segment.deduction). Uses BufferedTextInput with replaceOnBurst so fast-burst laser input collapses to a single final value - exactly matches the burst test. Header toggles state 'Wandhöhe' <-> 'Wandfläche: X m²' reactively from sum.total.

/app/frontend/src/components/sketch/LaserSoundOptions.tsx:9-50 - Uses a module-local state (getLaserSoundSettings) + useEffect to loadLaserSoundSettings() on mount. Plays preview tone on every pickTone/changeVolume, matching spec ('each change plays the tone'). Volume-down disabled at <=25, volume-up disabled at >=100 (both reflected via color prop; HTML 'disabled' attribute was null in my probe but TouchableOpacity accessibilityRole makes click a no-op anyway).

/app/frontend/src/utils/laserFeedback.ts:7-58 - TONES array of 3 WAVs, per-tone lazy player cache (players[tone] = createAudioPlayer(TONES[tone])), setAudioModeAsync called once. setLaserTone/setLaserVolume write to AsyncStorage with correct keys 'aufmassprofi_laser_tone' / 'aufmassprofi_laser_volume'. Values clamped to [0, TONES.length-1] and [25, 100]. Default tone=0, default volume=100.

/app/frontend/services/ProjectPdfService.ts:618 computes wall area per sketch; :685 computes hasWalls; :696 switches column header 'Grundfläche' vs legacy 'm²'; :697 appends 'Wandfläche' column when hasWalls. Totals row at :708-712 also conditionally includes wallTotal. Correct backward-compat: projects with no polygonWalls data render the OLD single-'m²'-column layout.

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:7673-7677 progress text expression - off-by-one safe: segmentIndex is 0-based so 'Linie {segmentIndex+1}'. Correctly suppressed for <2 segments. 'alle bemaßt' triggers when open===0.

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:7786-7794 - WallHeightSection only rendered when the selected element is a polyline (closed or open). polygonWalls indexed by elementId, onChange replaces the whole wall object (keeps immutable state updates clean).

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx is now 9939 lines (grew 52 lines in iter 64, up from 9887 in iter 63). STILL violates the >700-line guideline. Suggest extracting the entire line-measure panel (lines ~7600-7900) and the Bemaßungspfeil modal (lines ~8200-8400) into their own components. Not caused by this iter but gets more painful every round.
The 'Add'/'Done' primary CTA at the bottom of the line-measure panel STILL has NO testID - carried over from iter 63. Please add testID='line-measure-done-button'.

success_rate.frontend: 8 of 10 feature points directly verified in automation + 2 covered by static code review (open-polyline progress 'von 3'; arrow modal LaserSoundOptions reflecting same tone/volume; in-editor cross-reload polygonWalls persistence). PDF HTML generation covered by code review only. No blocking defect found.

seed_data_creation: None server-side. Browser-side localStorage keys aufmassprofi_disclaimer_accepted='1', aufmassprofi_tour_done='1', aufmassprofi_sketch_tour_done='1' (pre-seeded), aufmassprofi_laser_tone='1' / aufmassprofi_laser_volume='50' / aufmassprofi_laser_sound='1' (pre-seeded for the persistence re-check in TEST_ITER64_E). ProjectIds used in query string only (no server round-trip observed): TEST_ITER64_A, TEST_ITER64_B, TEST_ITER64_C, TEST_ITER64_D, TEST_ITER64_E.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything from the iter-64 spec directly reachable in /sketches/draw automation passes. Remaining open items for future runs: (a) add testID='arrow-tool-button' to the arrow toolbar icon so Bemaßungspfeil modal can be reliably opened; (b) wrap the line-measure panel body in a ScrollView on phone widths so Cancel/Done stay visible with LaserSoundOptions + Wandhöhe expanded; (c) end-to-end 'press top-right check to save -> close editor -> reopen same project sketch -> wall values restored' requires the save flow not just page reload, so main agent should press the check button manually once and reopen the sketch. Unit tests: `cd /app/frontend && npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter64_wall_area.test.ts` -> OK; `npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter60_buffered_input_sequence.test.ts` -> OK.
rca_of_issue: No blocking defect found. All numeric results match spec (7,28 / 9,05 / 9,06 / 32,66 / 32,67 m²; 10,53 m² floor area). Only two cosmetic design nits (panel overflow on phone, 'Ton' chip label truncation) remain.
